free.metaDescription: Souschef is a free recipe keeper app for saving recipes from websites, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, photos, and text. Cooking and organization tools are free. Plus only adds unlimited imports.
free.h1: Recipe keeper that helps you actually cook
free.lead: A free recipe keeper for saving recipes from websites, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, photos, and text. Cooking and organization tools are free; Plus only adds unlimited imports.
free.disclaimer: Free plan includes 5 saved recipe imports per rolling 7 days.

recipe.metaDescription: Souschef is a recipe keeper and recipe organizer for saving recipes from websites, videos, and social media. Cook, shop, and journal for free. Plus adds unlimited imports.
recipe.h1: Recipe keeper that helps you actually cook
recipe.lead: Save recipes from websites, videos, and social media, then organize and cook them in one place. Cooking and organization tools are free. Plus only adds unlimited imports.
recipe.disclaimer: Free plan includes 5 saved recipe imports per rolling 7 days.
